topic: POV: the Baby of Wall Street on a Monday
title: POV: the Baby of Wall Street on a Monday
hook: POV: the Baby of Wall Street on a Monday.

scenes.caption: Monday. 8 a.m. Briefcase packed.
scenes.image_prompt: walking through a glass office entrance in a tiny navy suit carrying a small leather briefcase, serious face, morning light

scenes.caption: The meeting could have been an email.
scenes.image_prompt: sitting at a long conference table in a meeting with adult coworkers, visibly bored, chin resting on hand

scenes.caption: Third coffee. Still tired.
scenes.image_prompt: at an office desk with two monitors, drinking from a baby milk bottle held like a coffee mug, tired eyes

scenes.caption: Someone forgot to refill the milk.
scenes.image_prompt: standing on an office chair behind a big boss desk, pointing firmly at the door, an adult employee walking out sadly with a cardboard box

scenes.caption: Overtime hits different.
scenes.image_prompt: asleep face-down on a keyboard at an office desk at night, loosened tie, city lights through the window

outro: Same job tomorrow. Would you hire him?
description: Bo, the Baby of Wall Street, survives another Monday. Meetings, milk and overtime.
visual_prompt: in a tiny navy business suit standing in a modern office lobby, confident pose
